opening.speech: My sister says not to talk to people about the beacon. So I will say the sheep are fine and you can make what you like of the sheep being fine.

choices.text: Who came up the path that morning?

sheep.speech: Fine. Better than fine. Nobody has been up here at night for two nights, which they like, and there was a cart on the low road four days ago, which they did not like at all.

choices.text: Who came up the path that morning?

path.speech: A man in good boots. He talked to Nesh for a long time and then he went down again and he never once looked at the sea. I look at the sea and I am the stupid one.
